relationships.mechanism: Mortgage rates and credit → transactions/starts → building products, appliances, furniture, moving/storage and brokerage
relationships.monitor: Track permits, starts, completions and financing separately; completions create apartment supply while transactions stimulate repair and moving demand.
relationships.failure_of_inference: Builder incentives can support new-home sales while existing-home turnover remains weak. Do not infer one broad housing recovery from a single series.

relationships.mechanism: Funded compute demand → energized data centers → networks/chips/equipment → generation and grid investment
relationships.monitor: Match signed customer commitments, grid rights, construction, equipment delivery and in-service dates. Track gross profit and funded returns at each supplier.
relationships.failure_of_inference: A megawatt may appear in several announcements. Avoid counting the same project as independent demand and capitalizing everyone at scarcity margins.

relationships.mechanism: End-user orders → distributor inventory → component/plant production → freight and warehousing
relationships.monitor: Align sell-in, sell-through, shipments and inventories by calendar. Require orders plus actual use plus cash conversion before calling a broad recovery.
relationships.failure_of_inference: Restocking can lift manufacturers ahead of final demand; heavier freight mix or fuel surcharge revenue can mimic unit growth.

relationships.mechanism: Payer pricing/utilization → provider staffing and collections → equipment/supplies/drugs → property operator coverage
relationships.monitor: Map who bears claims risk, who bills, who gets paid and on what lag; compare reimbursement growth with labor, acuity and denial costs.
relationships.failure_of_inference: Higher utilization may help suppliers/providers but hurt insurers. More covered lives need not create equivalent recognized revenue or landlord rent coverage.

relationships.mechanism: Lending standards/rates → borrower liquidity → defaults and collateral values → bank/insurer/REIT capital
relationships.monitor: Build maturity and funding ladders, then test operating cash and collateral values together. Watch covenant headroom and required capital, not just interest coverage.
relationships.failure_of_inference: Lower rates can relieve borrowers while compressing investment spreads or accelerating mortgage prepayments. Asset and liability duration must be matched.

relationships.mechanism: Claims inflation/catastrophes → insurance pricing → broker commissions → customer expenses/property cash
relationships.monitor: Compare rate with exposure and loss trend; trace premium increases into broker revenue and insured-property expense. Check reinsurance terms and retained catastrophe risk.
relationships.failure_of_inference: An insurer's favorable investment income does not fix inadequate reserves; rising premiums can raise broker revenue while weakening customers' occupancy or operating margins.

relationships.mechanism: Customer contracts → working capital/construction → revenue recognition → cash collection → shareholder cash
relationships.monitor: Record contract enforceability, termination terms, milestone timing, funding source and diluted shares. Match business perimeter across statements.
relationships.failure_of_inference: Backlog, rate authorization, eligible lives, leased megawatts and acquisition accretion all precede cash. None independently proves funded per-share value creation.

universe_coverage.basis: a group whose classified constituent count is below the sample floor cannot reach the floor however many weeks the price warm-up runs — it is short of CLASSIFIED CONSTITUENTS, not of prices, and its statistics will read insufficient_sample every week until more companies are classified into it.
